content: We report and discuss the results of our two tasks in four subsections. The first and second subsections include the effect of local representation and distant representation, respectively. The impact of CVT is explained in the third subsection. The last subsection presents a comparison of our model and all the baselines. Moreover, we also conduct paired t-tests to investigate the significance of the improvement from each contribution, as shown in Section SECREF9 .
